title: Add a contact route to every project and offer
problem: No phone/WhatsApp/form observed on 59 pages; only info@ emails found by deep scan
proposed_change: Sticky contact bar on mobile: call, WhatsApp, in-platform request with stated response time; state explicitly if platform-only contact
acceptance_criteria: Every project/offer shows ≥1 contact route above the fold at 360px; automated check: 0 pages without contact route
dependencies: Business decision on who receives requests; visual verification first

title: Resolve the market-indicators promise
problem: Homepage meta promises market indicators; /market is a coming-soon page
proposed_change: Publish dated and sourced indicators (even for two areas) or remove the promise from copy and navigation until available
acceptance_criteria: No 'coming soon' page reachable from navigation; each indicator carries date and source

title: Add About/Contact/Privacy/Terms pages with operator identity
proposed_change: Four simple pages in ckb/ar/en with legal entity, licence, address, phone/WhatsApp, email; linked in footer and on /register

title: Localise login and register pages
problem: Served in English (lang=en, 'Welcome back', 'Create your Andaz account') at the Kurdish default path
proposed_change: Translate headings, fields, errors, buttons into Sorani and Arabic; honour path locale
acceptance_criteria: html lang matches path locale; no English strings on ckb/ar auth pages

title: Show price basis on project pages
problem: No price/availability/payment terms in structured data or descriptions of 16 pages
proposed_change: Indicative price range or explicit 'price not published by developer' + payment basis + last price update date
acceptance_criteria: Every project page shows a dated range or the explicit absence statement
dependencies: Price source and verification policy; visual verification first

title: Fix raw translation key on /invest
proposed_change: Translate key; add CI check failing on raw keys in <title>/H1

title: Localise all 81 area names
problem: Arabic pages show Kurdish name in different spelling; English pages show transliteration 'kwrany nwe'
proposed_change: Reviewed name table for 81 areas in 3 languages; never fall back to transliteration
acceptance_criteria: 0 area titles containing Latin transliteration or foreign-script letters

title: Ship or hide the companies directory
proposed_change: Minimal directory (name, licence, projects, contact) or remove link until ready
acceptance_criteria: No navigation link leads to a coming-soon page

title: Make the owner/seller path explicit
problem: No 'list your property' path found; /pricing titled 'Internal valuation' is unclear to visitors
proposed_change: Homepage card explaining how owners sell/rent via the platform; rename /pricing to a visitor-facing label or make it internal
acceptance_criteria: A seller reaches a page explaining the steps (or stating company-only listing) within two taps

title: Add a one-sentence purpose line and three primary actions
problem: Two competing value propositions (valuation vs discovery)
proposed_change: Sentence under H1 combining both promises; buttons: Projects / For rent & sale / My property value

title: Normalise Kurdish/Arabic script and project names
problem: Mixed ی/ي and ک/ك, missing hamza, three spellings of one project name
proposed_change: Input/display normalisation; project-name glossary (one name per language); editorial review of imported text
acceptance_criteria: Automated check: 0 Arabic kaf/yeh in Kurdish text and vice versa; one name per project across title/description

title: Define minimum project content standard
problem: Some pages carry a one-line template or no description
proposed_change: Minimum fields per project + explicit 'incomplete information' badge instead of blank
acceptance_criteria: 100% published projects above minimum or explicitly badged

title: Redesign the 404 page
proposed_change: Site chrome, message in visitor language, three rescue links
acceptance_criteria: 404 has main navigation and 3 rescue links in 3 locales

title: Add H1 and titles to index pages
problem: No H1 and generic title on ckb/ar index pages
acceptance_criteria: Each index page has one visible H1 and unique title

title: Fix structured data and canonical policy
problem: addressLocality holds non-place values; localized project pages canonicalise to ckb URL
proposed_change: Map addressLocality to real area; self canonical + hreflang on every page
acceptance_criteria: Automated check: self canonical + 3 hreflang on all pages

title: Remove unfinished sections from navigation
problem: Links lead to coming-soon pages and a raw-key page
proposed_change: Hide or label unfinished links before the tap
